method: Primary-source live reads; anonymous public browser inspection; 2 Mobbin historical images + 2 live screenshots inspected; no login/signup/transactions/messages/API permission changes. Old local report used only as leads.

sources.title: V2 is here
sources.scope_version: Content Rewards V2 release announcement; not a build identifier
sources.section: Roles; One brand; Pre-approval; Campaign configuration; For creators; What is not here yet
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 活动归组织；代理商下设品牌。声明草稿版本、修改反馈、获准账号限制；素材文件、申请名额/截止、超时拒绝、草稿保存、预约发布。收益页列队列中/到达中/已收到。公告当时缺批量审核及投稿/创作者CSV，分析CSV仍有。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: 角色任命与P05不同；不能把申请自动拒绝等同于投稿自动审核。缺失能力是否后来补齐未知。

sources.title: For creators | Content Rewards
sources.scope_version: Current public creator landing page / FAQ
sources.section: FAQ: joining, submitting, rejected, reviewed; campaign model overview
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 有开放加入或申请；发布后30分钟内交链接；错平台、漏标签/披露、重用内容及发布后编辑/删除可拒绝。三种计酬为按观看、按篇、周期交付。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: P08帮助组件省略30分钟，不能推定取消；营销提现与收入数字不作为实测。

sources.title: For agencies | Content Rewards
sources.section: Reporting; Who approves; More than one client
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 客户品牌各有活动、预算、设置；按活动/平台/日看观看、获批稿、互动及有效CPM，声明分析CSV和分享链接。FAQ列七日审核窗口。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: P05称Pending等人工处理，没有定义七日超时结果；分析CSV不等于投稿CSV。

sources.title: Privacy policy | Content Rewards
sources.scope_version: Policy expressly covering Whop-hosted and CR web experiences
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 两种体验并存；登录经Whop。社交连接可走官方授权或简介验证码；声明只读、不代发。Instagram限专业/Creator，Facebook限管理的Page；断开停止追踪及该平台付款。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: 声明不是实际平台授权验收；连接可选不证明所有活动无需所有权验证。

sources.title: Organization terms of service | Content Rewards
sources.scope_version: New CR web campaigns/workspaces; legacy funded campaigns retain prior accepted terms
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 要求须在站内Requirements/Description；投稿人工审核，暂停关闭新稿但不取消已批付款。四角色、末位Owner保护、客户数据隔离；private不公开。未批准草稿无品牌使用权；批准与素材来源影响许可/归属。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: §11允许Owner/Admin改角色，与P01冲突；不能据此声称界面权限已验证。

sources.title: Creator terms of service | Content Rewards
sources.scope_version: CR web creator terms with express legacy carve-out
sources.evidence_paraphrase: 草稿获批不等于成稿通过；风险申诉与拒稿客服分开；风险申诉一次、目标十工作日答复。联名发布需活动允许。撤销连接及迁移有停追踪风险；重大变更用站内/邮件告知。
sources.limitations_or_contradictions: §17.6引用19.3/19.2疑似编号错误；不可据此自行修复法律含义。没有完整通知事件表。
